name: tos-checker
description: Flags the parts of a terms of service that people should know about before they click accept.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.pack:extension: npm run build && tar.exe -a -c -f tickwise-extension.zip -C dist/extension manifest.json popup.html popup.css popup.js lib.js icons fonts src
scripts.pack:firefox: npm run build && tar.exe -a -c -f tickwise-firefox.zip -C dist/firefox manifest.json popup.html popup.css popup.js lib.js icons fonts src
